design_philosophy: Calm, credible, and professionally gamified. The hiring manager dashboard is an operational B2B control room with high data density but minimal visual noise. The candidate experience is a focused, single-task interface utilizing the 'Bento focus' grid, characterized by generous negative space and subtle celebratory micro-interactions.

headings.usage: Use for all H1-H4 elements. Never center-align by default.

body.usage: Use for all paragraphs, labels, and dense text.

mono.usage: Use for candidate code snippets, AI logs, and technical metrics.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing (Tailwind Scale 2-3x normal). Focus on progressive disclosure for managers and single-task bento grids for candidates.

manager_dashboard.cards: border border-border/40 rounded-xl p-6 shadow-sm bg-white

candidate_experience.focus_area: col-span-full md:col-start-3 md:col-span-8 p-8 md:p-12 bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(10,15,26,0.04)] border border-border/40
candidate_experience.alignment: Strictly left-aligned content with massive horizontal padding.

header.classes: sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border-b border-black/5

buttons.primary: bg-[#1A2E35] text-white hover:bg-[#2C454E] hover:-translate-y-0.5 transition-all rounded-lg px-6 py-2.5 shadow-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent text-[#1A2E35] border border-black/10 hover:border-black/30 hover:bg-black/5 transition-all rounded-lg px-6 py-2.5

forms.inputs: bg-transparent border border-black/15 rounded-lg px-4 py-3 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#1A2E35]/20 focus:border-[#1A2E35] transition-all

gamification.progress_rings: SVG based, using #4A6B53 with stroke-dasharray transitions. Include subtle particle bursts (framer-motion) on 100% completion.
gamification.badges: Neumorphic subtle lift: bg-white border border-black/5 shadow-sm rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#4A6B53]

shadcn_overrides.cards: Remove default heavy shadows. Use border-black/5 with drop-shadow-sm. Increase internal padding to p-6 or p-8.
shadcn_overrides.dialogs: backdrop-blur-md bg-black/20 for overlay. Dialog window must have rounded-2xl and p-8.
shadcn_overrides.tabs: Override fixed h-9 on list. Use transparent backgrounds with border-b-2 active states instead of pill-bubbles for a mature B2B look.

ai_loading_state.description: Do not use standard spinners. Use a staggered text reveal or a glowing 'Tracing Beam' border on the card to indicate Claude is generating the case study.
ai_loading_state.classes: relative overflow-hidden before:absolute before:inset-0 before:-translate-x-full before:animate-[shimmer_2s_infinite] before:bg-gradient-to-r before:from-transparent before:via-black/5 before:to-transparent

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All interactive elements must lift slightly (-translate-y-0.5) and shift color. No element should rely on cursor alone.

icons.style: Duotone for candidate gamification badges and empty states. Regular weight for manager dashboard data tables and dense UI.

abstract_textures.description: Use these for candidate focus-mode backgrounds (subtle opacity) or login screen split-pane designs.

office_environments.description: Use for the marketing landing page or manager-side auth backgrounds to establish B2B credibility.

testing_attributes.rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
